chapter.verse: Ka itte aw, hih nih veina lai kong gelh hi.

Note in a siangtho kamsangte in nidang lai-inah a gensa thute ahi zongin, note sawltakte tungah hong piak Topa leh Honpa’ thupiakna ahi zongin, na ngaihsut nadingun, hih laikhak nihna sungah note lungsim siangtho uh hong phawksakin ka hong hansuah hi.
Amasa bel-a theih ding akilawm thu in a nunung bel nite ciangin a kosia thei mite in amaute’ deihgawhna bang gamta-in:

“Topa hong paikik ding cih thuciamna in koi-ah a om hiam? I pute i pate a si khin zo uh hi; ahi zongin na khempeuh a pian’sak cila kipan a pian’ ngei bangin a om lai hi,” ci-in kosiatna tawh a hong pai ding uh hi.
Tang lai-in Pasian’ thupiakna in van ahi zongin, tui sung pan pusuakin, tui tawh a kip lei ahi zongin,
tua thu tawh tua lai takin a om leitung, tui tawh tumin a kisiatna thu ahi zongin tua mite in a ciamteh nuam kei uh hi.
Tu-in a om van leh lei in Pasian bia lo mite kisiatna thukhen ni ading, tua thu hangin mei khul nadingin a kikoih khol zo hi.
Ahih hangin ka itte aw, Pasian ading ni khat in kum tul khat bang ahi zongin, kum tul khat in ni khat bang ahi zongin, hih thu khat na mangngilh kei un.
Mi kim khat in zekai-a a ciamteh theih uh bangin Pasian in a thuciamna-ah a zekai kei hi. Kuamah kisia loin, mi khempeuhte in kisikkikna a ngah nadingun deihin, amah in note hong thuak hi.

Guta bangin Topa’ Ni in hong tung ding hi. Tua Ni ciangin vantungte in aw lian mahmah tawh mangthang ding a, a nate zong sa lua-in a kisia ding uh hi. Leitunga kipan leitungah kibawl na khempeuh a kangtum ding uh hi.

Hih na khempeuh tua bangin mangthang ding ahih ciangin, vantungte in mei hangin kisia-in, vanah a om nate in sa lua-in a tuisuak ding hun Pasian’ Ni hong tung ding ci-in note in lamenin lawpin, gamtatna siangtho gamta-in, Pasian biakna-ah nopsakna tawh na om ding uh kilawm hilo ahi hiam?
Ama thuciamna bangin dikna a om van thak leh lei thak eite in i lamen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka itte aw, note in hih nate lamenin na om uh ahih ciangin, ama mai-ah mawhsakna om lo, ninna tawh kinuh loin nuam takin na om nadingun na hahkat un.

I it i sanggampa Paul in a ngah lungpilna bangin no kiangah gelhin hong piak lai ahi zongin, ama thuhilhna lai khempeuh ah ahi zongin, hih nate tawh kizomin a gelh mah bangin i Topa’ thuakna in gupna thu ahi ci-in na ciamteh un.
Tua laite sungah a tel hak thu zong a om hi. A siam lo mi, a kip lo mite in tua thute-a kipan a om lai Lai Siangtho khiatna lumletin amau pumpi uh a siasak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka itte aw, mi gilote khialhna note in zui-in note lungkipna uh pan na puk loh nadingun, tua nate thei khol na hih ciangun na kikem un.
Hehpihna thupha ah ahi zongin, i Topa leh Honpa Zeisu Khazih theihtelna ah ahi zongin na khangto un. Tua Topa tungah tu-a kipan a tawntungin minthan’na om ta hen. Amen.
